restaurant_name: APEX Clinic - Terminal Pattaya (เอเพ็กซ์ คลินิก เทอร์มินอล พัทยา)
text:
With over 1,000 reviews and a perfect 5.0 rating, expectations were understandably high. Unfortunately, my consultation experience did not reflect that level of quality.
I asked for a very conservative, targeted Botox treatment with a clearly defined low number of units. Instead, I was told that only fixed per-vial packages are offered, with no possibility for individualized dosing. This approach may be convenient from a business perspective, but it does not align with a patient-centered medical consultation.
Communication at the front desk was dismissive and unhelpful, and there was no real effort to clarify questions or involve a doctor properly. Combined with a price of 9,900 THB for Botox, which is extremely high even by European standards, the overall experience felt overpriced and impersonal.
While the clinic looks modern, the consultation lacked professionalism, transparency, and individualized care.
